name: hud_ui_composite_panel_set_pos
description: HudUiCompositePanel::SetPos updates the composite panel position, invalidates it, computes entry height through HudUiPanel::QueryTextHeight, and positions each entry at baseY plus one line height per entry.
known_limits: Depends on HudUiPanel::QueryTextHeight, which is functionally accepted but still has a small local byte-shape mismatch.
VC5SP3 byte comparison remains open after source-owner rename from LayoutEntries to SetPos; use python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4bb9f0 for current drift.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja shows thiscall with x/y stack arguments, vtable invalidate at slot 0x20, QueryTextHeight, vector count from begin/end, GetY/GetX virtual calls through slots 0x68 and 0x64, then entry SetPos through slot 0x0c for each 0x2c0-byte entry.
The native layout smoke validates panel x/y update, invalidation side effect, and two entry SetPos results with the recovered line-height spacing.
